mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units, sustained for 2 months, indicates strengthening demand, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or HOUST-surged periods show no significant difference in 5-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when UNRATE falls below 4.2% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000 jobs per month, the combined labor market strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock performance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the joint labor market condition shows no significant predictive power (logistic regression p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals reduced supply chain pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in INDPRO-declined periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high and rising GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP and stock market correlation
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 2.5-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high-GDP periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: when CPIAUCSL exceeds 205, signaling heightened inflation concerns, the S&P 500 forward returns are predicted to be negative over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or high-CPIAUCSL periods show no significant difference in 5-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when UNRATE rises above 5% and PAYEMS growth slows to below 50,000 jobs per month, the combined labor market weakness predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock performance
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 45% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the joint labor market condition shows no significant predictive power (logistic regression p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a post-shock recovery regime, a resurgence in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 3-month moving average predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window in post-shock recovery regimes, or 60-day forward returns in RSAFS-resurged periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
